note: The original is in German; the text was extracted by OCR from the library scan on Internet Archive (archive.org item biostor-232733). A few figures and letters have recognition errors and have been checked against the context and the plate captions; figures that could not be confirmed have not been entered. The original description covers the soldier and a young worker.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 3.1 mm, head length 1.53 mm, head width 0.95 mm, frontal process length 0.63 mm. Distinguished from Eutermes fulviceps as follows: the frontal outline is straighter; the abdominal setae are sparser, the middle of the abdomen usually without setae; the abdominal tergites are rusty yellow; the antennal structure differs — antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 3 distinctly longer than segment 4.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: (Young stage) body length 3.9 mm, head length 1.20 mm, head width 1 mm. Head plate pale brownish grey, body greyish white, the brownish grey intestinal contents visible through the posterior part; head with short hairs, the rest of the pilosity as in the soldier; head without a fontanelle, the cranial suture distinct and pale; basal tooth of the left mandible almost quadrangular. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 together, segment 5 shorter than segment 2.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Very close to Eutermes arcanus fulviceps and rather difficult to distinguish. Type locality: Tuiche, Caupolicán province, Bolivia.
